name: com.crawfissoftware.common
description:
Game-neutral building blocks shared across CrawfisSoftware Unity projects: the EventChainDispatcher/AutoEventFlowBase pair that backs every auto-event flow and cross-domain bridge, additive scene-management components driven by events, a difficulty config, and small utilities.

REQUIRES com.crawfissoftware.eventspublisher, which is distributed by git URL and therefore cannot be declared as a resolvable dependency here. Add it to your project manifest yourself - see the README.
